hero.titleMain: Run your school, college or coaching center —
hero.lead: RootEd is the system schools, colleges and coaching or tuition centers use to run attendance, fees, staff and inventory in one place. Multi-tenant, role-based, and built with the same data-safety discipline as a bank's back office.
hero.fineprint: Free to use, no credit card. Already a RootEd school?

preview.heading: A dashboard for every role — not just one
preview.body: Each login sees a view scoped to what they're permitted to see, enforced by RBAC, not just hidden nav items. Shown here: the principal's view — attention strip, attendance/fee/grade KPIs, 7D trend, date picker to rewind any past day. Parents and students feel the results too — fees paid on time, report cards that are accurate — without a login of their own to manage.

modulesSection.heading: Five modules. One tenant. Zero spreadsheets.
modulesSection.lead: Everything your organisation runs day to day, already wired together — a student's attendance record, fee balance and report card live in the same system, not three disconnected tools.
modulesSection.allConnectedBody: One login, one dataset, per school — a fee defaulter list and an attendance report can reference the same student record.

academics.body: Attendance, grades, timetable, report cards and academic years — one record per student, not a spreadsheet per teacher.

fee.title: Fee
fee.body: Fee structures, collection, Razorpay online payments and receipts — parents pay online, you see it reconcile automatically.

expense.title: Expense
expense.body: Expense entries with approval chains and auto-escalation, plus budgets — every rupee spent has a paper trail.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.body: Stock tracking, depreciation, and overdue-return alerts — know what your school owns and where it went.

multiTenant.title: Multi-tenant
multiTenant.body: One deployment, many schools, colleges and coaching centers — your data is tenant-scoped and enforced at the database-query layer, not just hidden in the UI.

rbac.title: Three-tier RBAC
rbac.body: Super Admin → Tenant Admin → module-permissioned roles. A librarian can't see payroll. A teacher can't see budgets.

i18n.title: English · Hindi · both

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.body: Leave, expense and purchase requests move through a real approval chain with auto-escalation — nothing sits forgotten.

pricingSection.heading: Free forever. Premium when you need it.

securitySection.heading: Your staff's bank details and your students' records — protected on purpose, not by accident.
securitySection.lead: School data is sensitive: staff government IDs, bank accounts, salaries, student records. Here's specifically what protects it.

isolation.title: Tenant isolation enforced at the database layer
isolation.body: Every query is automatically checked for your school's tenant ID before it runs. A bug that tries to read another school's data fails outright — it doesn't quietly return the wrong rows.

pii.title: Encrypted staff PII
pii.body: Government ID, bank account and salary fields are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, with a separate encryption key derived per school — not one shared key for every tenant.

audit.title: Immutable audit log
audit.body: Every change to sensitive records is written to an audit log as a before/after diff that can't be edited after the fact — you can always answer "who changed this, and when."

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How Rural Root Cloud Tech Services And Training handles personal data in RootEd, the school management platform at rooted.ruralrootcloud.com.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.body:
RootEd is operated by Rural Root Cloud Tech Services And Training (“we”, “us”), India.

RootEd is a business tool sold to schools, colleges and coaching centres. Two different relationships matter throughout this policy:

- For the account you sign in with, we are the data fiduciary: we decide how your name, email and sign-in details are handled.
- For the records your school keeps in RootEd — students, attendance, grades, fees, staff — your school is the data fiduciary and we act on its instructions as a data processor. Questions about those records should go to your school first.

whatWeCollect.title: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body:
Account data you give us: first and last name, email address, username, phone number (optional), profile photo (optional), and a password, which is stored only as an Argon2id hash and never in readable form.

Security data we generate: sign-in timestamps and IP address, failed sign-in counts, and a two-factor secret if you enable it.

School records your organization enters: student and staff details, attendance, grades and report cards, timetables, fee structures and payments, expenses, payroll and inventory. Staff government ID numbers, bank account details and salary figures are additionally encrypted field by field.

Technical data: browser and device type, and server request logs used to keep the service running and secure.

We do not use advertising SDKs, we do not sell personal data, and the Android app requests no contacts, location, SMS or call-log permission.

howWeUse.title: How we use it
howWeUse.body:
- To run the service: authenticate you, apply your role's permissions, and show you your organization's data.
- To keep it secure: rate limiting, session revocation, and an immutable audit log of changes.
- To communicate: email verification, password resets, invitations, and approval notifications.
- To meet legal obligations and resolve disputes.

We do not use your data or your school's records to train machine-learning models.

childrenData.title: Children's data
childrenData.body:
RootEd is not directed at children and has no student sign-in. Accounts are held by adults — administrators, principals, teachers, accountants and librarians.

RootEd does hold records about students, some of whom are minors, but those records are entered and controlled by the school. The school is responsible for obtaining any consent required from parents or guardians under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and for deciding who on its staff may see them.

If you believe a child's data is in RootEd without a proper basis, contact your school, and contact us at the address below.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body:
We share personal data only with processors that are needed to run the service:

- Razorpay Software Private Limited — processes online fee payments. Card and bank details are entered on Razorpay's own checkout and never reach our servers.
- Cloudflare — routes and protects traffic to the service.
- Our own object storage, used for documents and photos uploaded to RootEd.

We also disclose data where the law requires it, and to a successor if the business is transferred. We do not sell personal data or share it with advertisers.

security.title: How we protect it
security.body:
- All traffic is encrypted in transit with HTTPS.
- Passwords are hashed with Argon2id.
- Staff government ID, bank account and salary fields are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM, using a key derived separately for each organization.
- Every organization's data is isolated at the database-query layer, not by application convention, so one school cannot read another's records.
- Access inside an organization is limited by role, and optional two-factor authentication is available on every account.
- Changes are recorded in an audit log that cannot be edited.

No system is perfectly secure. If you discover a vulnerability, please report it to us rather than disclosing it publicly.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body:
- Account data: for as long as your account exists, then removed as described in Deleting your account.
- School records: for as long as your school keeps them. Schools frequently have statutory retention duties for academic and financial records.
- Audit logs: 90 days, then deleted automatically.
- Sessions: access tokens last 15 minutes, sign-in sessions 7 days.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.body:
Subject to applicable law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you may ask to access the personal data we hold about you, correct it if it is wrong, have it deleted, or complain to a supervisory authority.

You can change your name, phone number, username, email address and password yourself in Settings → Account.

Where the data belongs to your school's records rather than your account, we will pass your request to the school, because it decides what happens to those records.

deletion.title: Deleting your account
deletion.body:
You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Account → Delete account, or by writing to us.

The full description of what is deleted, what is kept, and why, is on the Delete your account page.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: RootEd sets only the cookies it needs to work: a sign-in session cookie and a cross-site request forgery protection cookie. There are no advertising or tracking cookies, so there is nothing to opt out of.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We will update this page when our practices change and move the date at the top. If a change materially affects you, we will also tell you in the app or by email.

acceptance.body:
By creating an account or using RootEd, you agree to these terms. If you are agreeing on behalf of a school or company, you confirm you are authorised to bind it.

service.title: What RootEd is
service.body:
RootEd is a multi-tenant school management platform covering academics, staff, fees, expenses and inventory. It is provided as a hosted service; we may add, change or remove features.

RootEd is an administrative tool. It is not a substitute for your own statutory records, and it does not provide legal, financial or educational advice.

accounts.body:
You must give accurate details, keep your password confidential, and tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access. You are responsible for what happens under your account.

Where RootEd is used to collect school fees, the contract for those fees is between the school and the payer. We provide the software. Online payments are handled by Razorpay under its own terms, and refunds of school fees are a matter for the school.

whatHappens.title: What gets deleted

whatIsKept.title: What is kept, and why
whatIsKept.body:
Records that belong to your school rather than to you are kept, with your name removed:

- attendance registers, grades and report cards;
- fee receipts, payroll and expense records; and
- security audit entries, which are automatically deleted after 90 days.

These are the school's statutory records. Deleting them would destroy the school's own accounts and academic history, and schools are required to retain many of them. After your deletion they no longer identify you — actions you took appear against a deleted user.

If you want school records about you removed as well, ask your school directly; it controls them.

inApp.title: Deleting from inside the app
inApp.body:
1. Sign in to RootEd.
2. Open Settings → Account.
3. Scroll to Delete account.
4. Enter your current password and type DELETE to confirm.
5. Press Delete my account.

Deletion happens immediately.

onlyAdmin.title: If you are the only administrator
onlyAdmin.body:
If you are the last administrator of an active organization, deletion is refused and RootEd tells you which organization is blocking it.

This protects your colleagues: with no administrator left, nobody could invite members, assign roles or manage the organization, and there would be no way back in.

Make another member an administrator first, or delete the organization, then delete your account.

byEmail.title: If you cannot sign in
byEmail.body:
Email info@ruralrootcloud.com from the address on your account with the subject “Delete my RootEd account”.

We will verify that you own the address before acting, and may ask your organization's administrator to confirm. We will not act on a request we cannot verify.

timeline.title: How long it takes
timeline.body:
Deletion from inside the app is immediate.

Email requests are completed within 30 days. Encrypted backups are rotated out within a further 30 days, after which no copy remains.
